title: Desk -> Chart webhook body
description: What the desk sends Chart on every coach call (commands.coach_context). Compact: no raw bars, no keys, no tokens other than the reply_to link.

message.description: Nick's text, or 'Explain this plan in 2-4 lines using its numbers only: ...'

policy.description: version, stop_cap text, per_trade_cap/daily_loss/weekly_loss (null = no dollar limit), exit_profile

session.description: date, time ET, state (PREMARKET/ORB FORMING/OPEN/NO NEW ENTRIES/ALL OUT/AFTER HOURS/CLOSED), last_entry, all_out, early_close, window

price_src.description: where the price came from (Schwab stream/REST, or a labeled fallback)

read.description: day_type, daily, vs_vwap, vs_200s, chop, trend (per timeframe), rsi, macd, rvol, setups, above/below levels

active_plan.description: The plan to explain. Never change its numbers.

contract.description: label, bid, ask, delta, feed (provider name); tradable only when context.data.executable is true

exit.description: stop (premium), stop_px (underlying price, finished 1m close), t1 (model premium), t1_name, t1_level, rr_underlying, rr_option, be_trigger, be_stop, stall_min, flat_by, all_out, loss_per_contract, ceiling_per_contract

entry_mode.description: VWAP + MACD only: 'VWAP retest' or 'early: strong trend'

open_real.description: Nick's open trades: ticker, contract, qty_open, fill, premium_stop, stop_px (underlying), t1, t1_level, be_hit, green

budget_real.description: realized_day, realized_week, unrealized, open_risk, trades_today (left = null: no dollar limit)

desk_plans_for_ticker.description: true for SPY/QQQ; false for watchlist tickers (Chart answers, no desk plan)

watchlist_quote.description: for watchlist tickers: last, chg_pct, spark, earnings {date, days}

alt_data.description: Quiver smart-money data for watchlist tickers when QUIVER_KEY is set

cards.description: 3 most relevant knowledge cards {id, title, status, summary}

rules.description: Nick's current rules (stops by window, management, size, delta, streak, limits, session, no-chase). Always current; wins over older notes.

training.description: library page names, source precedence, and data feeds (candles, options_feed live/delayed)

data.description: label: 'LIVE (Schwab stream)' / 'Schwab REST polling' / 'FALLBACK - not executable'; provider; executable (true only for Schwab)

regime.description: label (trend up/down, range/chop, volatility expansion, event-driven, mixed, insufficient) and the evidence behind it (ADX, DI, efficiency, VWAP crossings, overlap, ORB acceptance, event state)

levels.description: the engine's levels, each {value, source}: PDH/PDL/PDC (prior RTH), PMH/PML, ORB_H/ORB_L (DEVELOPING until 09:45), VWAP, POC/VAH/VAL (approximate)
